entities.summary: Zannone is an island in the Tyrrhenian Sea off the west coast of Italy. It is part of the Pontine Islands and belongs administratively to the comune of Ponza. The entire island is about 1 square kilometre in size and about 10 km (6 mi) from Ponza island.
